headline: Akihiro Miwa, Actor and Singer With Gender-Fluid Glamour, Dies at 91
context: In Japan, he was one of the first androgynous pop-culture stars and an inspirational figure. Abroad, he was known for his work in animated films by Hayao Miyazaki.
